g.title: How facts are written, recalled and checked
g.text: How facts are written, recalled and checked
02 / REQUEST FLOWS Amber = writes · teal = exact reads · purple dashed = ranked candidates

g.title: cluster_C / KEYWORD, SEMANTIC OR HYBRID SEARCH
g.text: C / KEYWORD, SEMANTIC OR HYBRID SEARCH

a.xlink:title: Obtain confirmation | Show the value, provenance and fact ID | Require ARCHIVE <id> or DELETE <id> | Skill / application owns this interaction
a.text: Show the value, provenance and fact ID

a.xlink:title: Archive or forget | CLI requires --fact-id and --confirm | API caller must obtain consent first | Ordinary correction preserves history
a.text: API caller must obtain consent first

a.xlink:title: Hide or permanently delete | Archive: hidden from current lookup | Forget: remove fact, evidence + caches | Earlier backups / exports retain copies
Query + explicit filters | Default: keyword, current, 5 results | Subject, predicate, context, time scope | Semantic mode needs a local provider
a.text: Semantic mode needs a local provider

a.xlink:title: Generate ranked fact IDs | FTS5 BM25 and/or local cosine scores | Reuse or refresh cached embeddings | Hybrid merges ranks: RRF, k = 60 | Vectors propose; they do not assert
a.text: FTS5 BM25 and/or local cosine scores
Vectors propose; they do not assert

a.xlink:title: Verify, filter, limit | Reapply subject / lifecycle / time filters | Return SearchHit with full fact evidence | score + methods + semantic similarity | Caller checks relevance before answering
a.text: Return SearchHit with full fact evidence

a.xlink:title: Resolve the identity | UUID / normalized canonical name / alias | Type may disambiguate a known entity | Unknown or ambiguous: stop and clarify
a.text: Type may disambiguate a known entity
Unknown or ambiguous: stop and clarify

a.xlink:title: Apply exact constraints | Subject + predicate + optional context | Current, history or validity at a time | answer(): known rules or explicit error
a.text: Current, history or validity at a time
answer(): known rules or explicit error

a.xlink:title: Return the evidence | Value / relationship + context | Source, confidence, status and dates | why_matched + supersession linkage
Resolve & validate | Stable entity + snake_case predicate | JSON value + context + source | Timezone-aware validity / observation
Compare the current slot | Same assertion: add observation | Different value: close + supersede old | Insert replacement + observation
One current fact per slot | (subject, predicate, context) | Unique index + interval validation | History and provenance remain intact
